title: W2 fix not honest: HUD legend promises lead-time reaction windows the sim never enforces
evidence:
lead_s := fmt.tprintf("node strain ~%ds to critical · node critical ~%ds · pipe ~%ds to saturation — ring + glyph, never color alone",
		wb.node_strained_lead_ticks / u64(hz), wb.node_critical_lead_ticks / u64(hz), wb.pipe_pressure_lead_ticks / u64(hz))

#   host Node_Strained @1 (2 waiting = 75% of the 80 u/s host throughput),
#   host Node_Critical @2 (4 waiting = 150%), red until the 30s draw opens
detail: AC: warning signs "all with lead times [FORGE #3]". The legend converts the leads to seconds and labels them "to critical"/"to saturation", but the strained->critical gap in the story's own golden is 1 tick (50 ms), not 30 s — the displayed window is a promise the sim contradicts.
recommended_fix: Either reword to "configured lead times (GDD targets)" without causal claims, or make the sim honor the leads before the caption can assert them.
